charselect.gamemode.locked: This is a %s character and cannot change gamemode.
charselect.select.title: Select Character
charselect.select.empty: No characters yet. Create one to start playing.
charselect.select.delete.title: Delete '%s'?
charselect.select.delete.message: This character and everything it is carrying will be gone for good. Your worlds are not affected.
charselect.select.fancymenu_hint: FancyMenu not set up for this screen — see docs
charselect.map.wrong_world: This map was generated in a different world and cannot be used
charselect.select.restore.title: Restore '%s' to before cheats?
charselect.select.restore.message: This character will go back to exactly how it was the moment before it first entered a world with cheats. Everything done since then is lost for good.
charselect.entry.blocked.title: This world is closed to this character
charselect.entry.blocked.message: %s has been in a world with cheats, and this world was created to only accept characters that never have.
charselect.entry.gamemode.title: Different gamemode
charselect.entry.gamemode.message: %s is a %s character and this is a %s world. Enter anyway?
charselect.entry.cheats.title: This world has cheats enabled
charselect.entry.cheats.message: %s will be marked as having used cheats, and will no longer be able to enter worlds that require a clean character. A copy of the character as it is right now will be kept, so you can restore it later from the character list.
charselect.createworld.ban_cheated.toolt: Only characters that have never entered a world with cheats may play here.
charselect.createworld.ban_cheated.hint: Turning this on disables cheats and cannot be changed later.
charselect.create.title: Create Character
charselect.create.gamemode.hint.survival: Survival characters can only enter survival worlds, and can never switch to creative.
charselect.create.gamemode.hint.creative: Creative characters can only enter creative worlds, and may switch modes freely.
charselect.create.gamemode.locked: Gamemode is fixed when a character is created.
charselect.create.hardcore.tooltip: This character is lost for good when it dies. Survival only, and cannot be changed later.
charselect.hardcore.died: %s has died. Hardcore characters do not come back.
charselect.create.slots_full: All %s character slots are in use.
charselect.edit.title: Edit Character
charselect.edit.convert.title: Convert '%s' to creative?
charselect.edit.convert.message: Makes a new creative character carrying a full copy of '%s' - its inventory, progress and everything else. The original survival character is left exactly as it is, untouched.

charselect.skin.error.not_png: That file is not a readable PNG.
charselect.skin.error.save_failed: The skin could not be saved.
charselect.skin.error.unreadable: That file could not be read.
charselect.skin.error.dialog_failed: The file dialog could not be opened.
charselect.skin.error.bad_username: That is not a valid Minecraft username.
